map.HTTP 请求方法语义速查。: A quick reference to the semantics of HTTP request methods.
map.：GET 获取、POST 提交/创建、PUT 整体替换、PATCH 局部更新、D: : GET retrieves, POST submits or creates, PUT replaces the whole resource, PATCH updates it partially, DELETE removes it, HEAD fetches headers only and OPTIONS asks what is supported.
map.：GET、HEAD、OPTIONS 为安全方法，不应改变服务器资源状态。: : GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are safe methods and should not change the state of a server resource.
map.：GET、PUT、DELETE 幂等（多次执行结果相同）；POST 不幂等。: : GET, PUT and DELETE are idempotent (repeating them gives the same result); POST is not.
map.：PUT 需提交完整资源，PATCH 只提交变更字段。: : PUT submits the complete resource, whereas PATCH submits only the changed fields.
map.核对接口文档：确认团队约定的方法与语义一致，避免所有操作都用 POST 导致缓存: Checking the API contract: confirm your team's agreed methods match their semantics — if every operation uses POST, caching and retry policies all stop working.
map.排查网关拦截：某些代理默认只允许 GET/POST，用到 PUT/DELETE: Debugging a gateway block: some proxies allow only GET/POST by default, so PUT and DELETE get rejected; allow them explicitly in the gateway or CORS configuration.
map.GET 获取、POST 创建、PUT 替换、DELETE 删除。: GET retrieves, POST creates, PUT replaces and DELETE removes.
map.GET 请求能带请求体吗？: Can a GET request carry a body?
map.规范上不禁止，但实践中不应这么做：多数服务器会忽略 GET 的请求体，CDN 与: The specification does not forbid it, but in practice you should not: most servers ignore a GET body, and CDNs and proxies may drop it outright, making the behaviour unpredictable. When you need to pass complex query conditions, use POST instead, or encode the conditions into the query string (mind the URL length limit).
map.POST 为什么刷新会提示重新提交？: Why does refreshing a POST prompt to resubmit?
map.因为 POST 是非幂等的，刷新意味着可能重复下单或重复写入。服务端应配合 PR: Because POST is not idempotent, so refreshing might place the same order or write the same record twice. The server should follow the PRG pattern (Post/Redirect/Get): after handling the POST, return a 302 redirect to the result page, so a refresh repeats only the GET. This is also why delete operations should be made idempotent.
